subject: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

messages.author: 56e294258fa8fca7
messages.subject: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
parts:
Hi,

My problem is not new but I don't find any answer for it.
Thus I tell you what it is. I build a shiny app which show 3 images at the same location but at different times. I count the time with Sys.time() and difftime(). The app stops when N reaches 4. N is incremented by 1 into input$OK observeEvent.
The shiny works until the end (locally, I don't already deploy it) as I write the right image into a common file 'image.jpg'.
Nevertheless I have the following message every time I click on the Next button.
Avis dans run(timeoutMs) :
  Unhandled error in observer: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
observeEvent(input$OK)
If you have any idea I'll be glad and grateful,
Stefane

Here is me server.R :

library(shiny)

DEBUG <<- TRUE
stuff <<- reactiveValues(PB = TRUE, react = FALSE, N = 1)

shinyServer(function(input,output,session) {
 session$sendCustomMessage(type = "sessionStarter", message = list())

 observeEvent(input$OK,{
  if(stuff$N == 4) stopApp(returnValue = TRUE)
  stuff$PB <<- TRUE
  stuff$N <<- stuff$N+1
  isolate(updateSliderInput('valence', value = 0))
 })

 output$image <- renderImage({
  if(stuff$PB) {
   time1 <<- Sys.time()
   stuff$PB <<- FALSE
   stuff$react <<- TRUE
   img <<- readImage(files = './1019_16.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
   writeImage(x = img, files = 'image.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
  }
  if(stuff$react) {
   time2 <<- Sys.time()
   delta <<- difftime(time2,time1)
   stuff$react <<- FALSE
   if(delta < 0.4) {
     stuff$react <<- TRUE
   } else if(delta < 0.8) {
     stuff$react <<- TRUE
     img <<- readImage(files = './1019_64.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
     writeImage(x = img, files = 'image.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
   } else {
     img <<- readImage(files = './1019.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
     writeImage(x = img, files = 'image.jpg', type = 'jpeg')
   }
  }
  list(src = imageFile, filetype = 'image/jpeg', width = 600)
 }, deleteFile = FALSE)
})
# shiny:::flushReact()




and my ui.R :

library(shiny)
# library(shinyapps)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
 titlePanel("",windowTitle = "Évaluation d'Amorçage Affectif"),
 mainPanel(
  fluidRow(column(1 ,actionButton(inputId = "OK",label = "Next"), offset = 7)),
  fluidRow(column(4, sliderInput(inputId = "valence",label = "Votre appéciation", min = -3, max = +3, step = 1, value = 0), offset = 6)),
  fluidRow(),
  fluidRow(column(4, imageOutput("image",width="100%"), offset = 2))
 ),
 tags$script(src = "my_alert.js")
))

messages.subject: Re: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
parts:
I'm not sure if this is the solution to your problem, but when you assign the member of a reactiveValues object like stuff, don't use <<-, just use <-; reactiveValues behave more like environment objects, than like list objects.

Also I don't really understand the relationship between the button, the time, and which image to show. Do you want to change images in between button presses, or not?

Stefane
